candidates.title: Snow Depths in Northern Colorado for 2002-2003
candidates.description: This data set consists of snow depth data from nine study areas, within three larger-scale areas in northern Colorado (Fraser, North Park, and Rabbit Ears Meso-cell Study Areas (MSAs)).

candidates.title: Map of Metro Districts in Colorado
candidates.description: Aggregated from thousands of local jurisdictions by the Colorado Department of Local Affairs Demography office. Many of the district boundaries were created from scanned drawings or digitized PDFs, and therefore no guarantee of accuracy can be made for the data.

candidates.title: Map of Highway Milepoints in Colorado
candidates.description: The mile points for every interstate highway in Colorado, from the Colorado Department of Transporation

candidates.title: Map of Highways in Colorado
candidates.description: Highway locations and various data: speed limits, surface type, access, etc, from the Colorado Department of Transportation (CDOT).

candidates.title: Map of Fire Districts in Colorado
candidates.description: Aggregated from thousands of local jurisdictions by the Colorado Department of Local Affairs (DOLA) Demography office. Many of the district boundaries were created from scanned drawings or digitized PDFs, and therefore no guarantee of accuracy can be made for the data.

candidates.title: Map of Alternative Fuels and Electric Vehicle Charging Station Locations in Colorado
candidates.description: Alternative Fuels and Electric Vehicle Charging Station locations are gathered by the National Renewable Energy Laboratory (NREL) and verified annually.

candidates.title: Map of Water and Sanitation Districts in Colorado
candidates.description: Aggregated from thousands of local jurisdictions by the Colorado Department of Local Affairs (DOLA) Demography office. Many of the district boundaries were created from scanned drawings or digitized PDFs, and therefore no guarantee of accuracy can be made for the data.

candidates.title: Population Projections in Colorado
candidates.description: Actual and predicted population data by gender and age from the Department of Local Affairs (DOLA), from 1990 to 2060.

candidates.title: Northern Colorado Snow Characteristics
candidates.description: This data set presents snow depth and snow wetness summary data from the Cold Land Processes Field Experiment (CLPX) in northern Colorado.
